text:
nilesh: Heads up — after pushing base-image rpi/ci:2026-03-18 with nvidia-container-toolkit 1.12.2 we're seeing ~15% of GPU containers crash on startup with missing libcuda/libnvidia-ml bind mounts.
nilesh: Sample error from kubelet logs:
````
containerd: failed to start container: mount failed: stat /run/nvidia/driver/libcuda.so.1: no such file or directory
````
sarah: Which hosts? any common kernel/driver version?
mike: Seen in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Nodes with driver 535.104 show it, 535.86 nodes are fine.
sarah: Could be toolkit path change + mount propagation (rshared vs rprivate). Did we change host image layout?
nilesh: We updated base-image to a slimmer layout and moved vendor libs from /opt/nvidia -> /usr/local/nvidia. The toolkit still assumes /run/nvidia symlinks on the host; new init uses rprivate mounts so container can't see the host symlink.
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started for base-images at 1812345600 by ci/pipeline #4823 :information_source:
tara: Can we pause the rollout? We should cordon nodes with failures before more images land.
mike: I've cordoned 4 problematic nodes in eu-west-1 and added label nvtoolkit-fix=pending.
sarah: Quick repro steps on an affected host:
```
# on host
ls -l /run/nvidia/driver
# shows libcuda.so.1 present

# in a container started on this host
docker run --rm --gpus all --privileged ubuntu:22.04 ls -l /run/nvidia/driver
# shows empty dir inside container
```
mike: That matches a bind-propagation issue — host has libcuda but container mount doesn't see it. New base-image changed systemd unit that sets MountFlags=private for /, breaking propagation.
nilesh: Short-term mitigation: pause base-image rollout, build new image pinned to toolkit 1.11.0 and revert the slim init change. Opening rollback task.
sarah: Mid-term: update node bootstrap to ensure GPU hostpaths are mounted with rshared propagation, and add an infra-test that starts a GPU container and asserts libcuda and libnvidia-ml are visible.
oncall: Alerting affected customers and creating an incident page: http://incident/INC-2026-187 — adding service desk contacts.
tara: Filing infra ticket INFRA-3245 with full kubelet logs and node list.
mike: Plan of action: rollback images (ETA 30m), cordon+drain affected nodes, restart kubelet on hosts where propagation changed, then uncordon. I'll own the rollback and node ops.
nilesh: Thanks — ping me when rollback starts. :thumbsup:
sarah: Note — double-check kernel revisions; one affected host had 6.1.0-rc which shows unusual behaviour but probably unrelated.
deploy-bot: Rollback job ci/rollback-4823 started at 1812345900.
mike: Rollback completed for eu-west-1 pool; monitoring shows ~90% of pods recovered. A couple nodes still require manual kubelet restart.
nilesh: Please attach incident doc and postmortem when available; will close this thread after that.
